description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ModelTreeAction' and several nested classes representing different types of actions (entity queries, scripts, services) within a widget model tree structure for the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for reading actions from XML, executing scripts, and invoking services, with a focus on tree-based widget modeling.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing a tree action in the widget model, with static methods to read node actions and sub-node actions, and nested classes for specific action types.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.EntityAnd
classes.description: Represents an entity query with 'AND' conditions, executes the query, and sets the result list iterator in the model sub-node.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.EntityCondition
classes.description: Represents an entity query with specific conditions, executes the query, and sets the result list iterator.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.Script
classes.description: Represents a script execution action, runs scripts from specified locations, and updates list iterators accordingly.

classes.name: ModelTreeAction.Service
classes.description: Represents a service invocation, executes the service, and processes the results into the context or model sub-node.

methods.name: readNodeActions
methods.description: Reads and creates a list of ModelAction objects from XML node actions.

methods.name: readSubNodeActions
methods.description: Reads and creates a list of ModelAction objects from XML sub-node actions.
